# PLAXIS 3D 2023.2

## Required build

- Product: PLAXIS 3D 2023.2 Input, Output, and Output Viewer
- Version: `23.2.1.1079`

## Purchase and download

1. Purchase a PLAXIS 3D subscription from the [Seequent PLAXIS 3D product page](https://www.seequent.com/products-solutions/plaxis-3d/).
2. Assign the PLAXIS entitlement to the Bentley ID used for installation.
3. Grant that Bentley ID the **Software Download** role.
4. Sign in to [Bentley Software Downloads](https://softwaredownloads.bentley.com/) with that Bentley ID.
5. Search for **PLAXIS 3D**.
6. Select release **PLAXIS 3D 2023.2.1**, version **23.02.01.1079**, architecture **x64**, and the required language.
7. Download the complete Windows installer.

Seequent links PLAXIS installation media to Bentley Software Downloads from its [PLAXIS support page](https://www.seequent.com/help-support/plaxis/). The [2023.2 release notes](https://bentleysystems.service-now.com/community?id=kb_article&sysparm_article=KB0107896) identify `23.2.1.1079` as PLAXIS 3D 2023.2.1.

## Install and activate

1. Install Bentley CONNECTION Client.
2. Run the PLAXIS 3D 2023.2.1 installer as Administrator.
3. Sign in to CONNECTION Client with the assigned Bentley ID.
4. Start PLAXIS 3D Input and confirm Subscription Entitlement Service authorization.
5. Keep Bentley credentials and entitlement data outside this repository.

## Verify

Run the `verify` command in `meta.json`. It checks the PLAXIS 3D Input, Output, and Output Viewer executables and their pinned ProductVersion.
